summary.text: Jeff Bradley is a Republican financial advisor who has represented District 123 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since 2014, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Bradley is a longtime resident of Hilton Head Island, South Carolina.
He earned a B.S. in public administration from the University of North Alabama in 1979 and has worked as a financial advisor since 1982.
Bradley is a chartered retirement planning counselor and an accredited asset management specialist.

Bradley is a trustee of the Community Foundation of the Lowcountry, chair of the finance committee for the South Carolina Commission on Higher Education KNOW2 Beaufort pilot program, co-founder of the Hilton Head Island GED Camp and president of Lowcountry Men of the Church.

In 2023-2024 he was first vice chair of the Education and Public Works Committee and chairman of the Regulations and Administrative Procedures Committee, and for 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Education and Public Works Committee.
